name: Build a suspension bridge
description: A suspension bridge with two tall towers, main cables draped between them, and a flat deck suspended below. Iconic landmark structure spanning gorges and rivers.
luau_source:
-- Suspension Bridge — towers, cables, and deck
local function buildSuspensionBridge(startPos, length)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "SuspensionBridge"
  local towerHeight = 24
  local towerSpacing = length * 0.35
  -- Two towers
  for _, tx in ipairs({ startPos.X + towerSpacing, startPos.X + length - towerSpacing }) do
    for _, offset in ipairs({ -2, 2 }) do
      local leg = Instance.new("Part")
      leg.Name = "TowerLeg"
      leg.Size = Vector3.new(2, towerHeight, 2)
      leg.Position = Vector3.new(tx + offset, startPos.Y + towerHeight / 2, startPos.Z)
      leg.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
      leg.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
      leg.Anchored = true
      leg.Parent = m
    end
    local cross = Instance.new("Part")
    cross.Name = "TowerCross"
    cross.Size = Vector3.new(6, 2, 2)
    cross.Position = Vector3.new(tx, startPos.Y + towerHeight - 2, startPos.Z)
    cross.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
    cross.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
    cross.Anchored = true
    cross.Parent = m
  end
  -- Deck
  local deck = Instance.new("Part")
  deck.Name = "Deck"
  deck.Size = Vector3.new(length, 1.5, 6)
  deck.Position = Vector3.new(startPos.X + length / 2, startPos.Y + 4, startPos.Z)
  deck.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Medium stone grey")
  deck.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
  deck.Anchored = true
  deck.Parent = m
  -- Main cables (sag curve using segments)
  local segs = 20
  for i = 0, segs - 1 do
    local t = i / segs
    local x = startPos.X + t * length
    local sag = math.sin(t * math.pi) * 16
    local y = startPos.Y + towerHeight - sag
    local cable = Instance.new("Part")
    cable.Name = "Cable_" .. i
    cable.Size = Vector3.new(length / segs + 1, 0.4, 0.4)
    cable.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(x + length / segs / 2, y, startPos.Z),
      Vector3.new(x + length / segs + length / segs / 2,
        startPos.Y + towerHeight - math.sin((t + 1 / segs) * math.pi) * 16, startPos.Z))
    cable.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
    cable.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    cable.Anchored = true
    cable.Parent = m
    -- Vertical suspender
    local suspender = Instance.new("Part")
    suspender.Name = "Suspender_" .. i
    suspender.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, y - (startPos.Y + 4), 0.3)
    suspender.Position = Vector3.new(x, (y + startPos.Y + 4) / 2, startPos.Z)
    suspender.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
    suspender.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    suspender.Anchored = true
    suspender.Parent = m
  end
  return m
end
return buildSuspensionBridge
